Name: Sinbad's Cellar
Author: Sinbad37
Description:
Sinbad's Cellar
[b]Sinbad's Cellar[/b] is a simple farmhouse cellar overhaul designed to make the most out of your underground space.
Instead of using your cellar exclusively for aging products, you can turn it into a versatile area for growing crops, placing processing machines, and organizing your casks, all in one place.
The mod includes [b]two different map sizes[/b], allowing you to choose the layout that best suits your farm and playstyle.
Features
[list]
[*][b]Two map sizes:[/b] Choose between a spacious Large version or a more compact Small version.[/*]
[*][b]Indoor farming:[/b] Grow crops in your cellar throughout the year, regardless of the season.[/*]
[*][b]Machine placement:[/b] Use the available space for kegs, preserves jars, and other processing equipment.[/*]
[*][b]Cask support:[/b] Continue aging wine, cheese, and other products just like in the vanilla cellar.[/*]
[*][b]Simple configuration:[/b] Switch between the two layouts through the mod's config file.[/*]
[/list]Configuration
You can choose your preferred cellar size by GMCM
file:
[list]
[*]Large, The larger layout, offering more room for farming and production. [b]Enabled by default.[/b][/*]
[*]Small, A more compact alternative for players who prefer a smaller space.[/*]
[/list]
